metadata.note: King’s Cross passenger services with a Welwyn Garden City timing in YA01. Hertford-loop routings, Moorgate services, empty stock and non-passenger operators are excluded. Header public times are used at King’s Cross; intermediate working times retain passing points and explicit dwell. Pass points are not passenger calls. Day restrictions apply to the local station bank, including previous-day tails. Temporary alterations are not applied.
